literal_meaning: মুখ থেকে ফসকে বেরিয়ে আসা (mouth slipping out)
figurative_meaning_en: To blurt out something unintentionally due to carelessness
similar_in_english: let the cat out of the bag
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে মুখ ফসকিয়ে গোপন কথাটা বলে ফেলল।
আলোচনার মাঝে মুখ ফসকানোর জন্য সবাই হাসল।
example_sentences_in_english: He blurted out the secret by letting it slip from his mouth.
Everyone laughed when she accidentally let the information slip during the discussion.
note: This idiom reflects everyday linguistic habits in Bengali, emphasizing verbal caution.
